subject: Clarification session & evidence roster for NovaCare SIG/SOC2 questions
messages:
From: James Porter <james.porter@novacarehealth.com>

Cc: sally.liu@novacarehealth.com, security@novacarehealth.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SIG questions — scheduling a short clarity session

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for sending the SIG questionnaire earlier this week. We did a first pass and have about 12 items where we need clarifications from the vendor (mostly around data residency, key rotation cadence, and logging granularity). Before we start pulling artifacts, could we schedule a short call to walk through the high-level questions and confirm what evidence you can provide?

High-level asks:
- 20–30 minute sync to avoid chasing documents we don't need
- Confirm whether Redwood will provide per-tenant audit logs and the retention policy for the hosted API
- Understand typical evidence formats (Excel matrix vs. exported logs vs. attestation letters)

We're based on Pacific time. Available windows this week: Tue 7/29 10–11am or Wed 7/30 2–4pm PT.

Can you confirm availability and who from Redwood should join? Also, if you can share a short agenda, we can invite the right reviewers on our side.

Thanks,
James Porter
Director, Information Security
NovaCare Health

[attachment: NovaCare_SIG_V2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

Subject: Re: Request: SIG questions — scheduling a short clarity session

James — thanks for the note and the draft SIG. Happy to run a short clarity session. Wed 7/30 2pm PT works for me and Monica; Marissa can join for evidence handoff details.

Proposed 25-minute agenda (so we keep it tight):
1) Quick intros & scope (3 min)
2) Top 6 clarifications you highlighted (10 min)
   - data residency options for Hosted vs Dedicated
   - per-tenant vs aggregated logs and retention windows
   - key management integrations (KMS/HSM) and rotation cadence
3) Evidence types we can provide and lead owners (7 min)
4) Next steps & mutual actions (5 min)

Evidence owners from Redwood (preliminary):
- Monica Patel: SOC2 evidence matrix, policies, and attestation letters
- Marissa Cole: system logs extracts, retained sample logs, and any exported KV-cache redaction notes

I'll share a short calendar invite in a minute. If you want to surface any one-off questions ahead of the call, drop them in reply and we can pre-stage artifacts.

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Security
Redwood Inference

Thanks — good to meet virtually today. Quick notes & actions captured during the 25-minute session: 

Attendees:
- James Porter (NovaCare)
- Sally Liu (NovaCare)
- Karthik Iyer (Redwood)
- Monica Patel (Redwood)
- Marissa Cole (Redwood)

Summary of clarifications (short):
- Data residency: Hosted API serves multi-tenant models by default in region X; Dedicated and Private deployments can be pinned to customer-specific regions or on-prem. Monica: we'll attach the specific region list and the VPC/private deployment checklist.
- Audit logs: Redwood provides request-level audit logs for Dedicated and Private. For Hosted API we provide aggregated request logs plus a per-API-key activity summary. Retention: hosted aggregated logs 90 days, dedicated per-tenant logs 365 days (configurable). Marissa: prepare sample log export (anonymized) and retention policy doc.
- KMS/HSM & rotation: Redwood integrates with customer KMS for Private and Dedicated; hosted keys are rotated quarterly and are managed by Redwood with an attestation. Monica: will provide KMS integration matrix and key rotation policy.
- Evidence format: We typically supply an evidence matrix (Excel) mapping SIG questions to artifacts, plus a ZIP of artifacts (policies, sample logs, attestation letter).

Action items (owners & ETA):
- Monica: upload SOC2/SIG evidence matrix and attestation letter to SharePoint (ETA 2025-07-31) [link: https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/novacare/sig]
- Marissa: produce anonymized sample logs export + short README on how to interpret fields (ETA 2025-08-04)
- Karthik: provide a short note on fallback policy and model variant routing (ETA 2025-07-31)
- NovaCare (James): share final list of the 12 specific questions prioritized (ETA 2025-07-31)

Attachments mentioned: redwood-soc2-evidence-matrix.xlsx (previewed during call).

Next steps: Monica will post the evidence matrix to the shared link; we'll route items to owners and confirm when the artifact ZIP is ready. If you need anything in a different format, say so in reply.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

[attachment: redwood-soc2-evidence-matrix.xlsx (Excel, 120KB)]

Appreciate the walkthrough earlier. Attached is the prioritized question list (Q1–Q12) we promised — two are blockers for procurement (Q3 on per-tenant logs and Q7 on cross-region backups).

We reviewed the evidence matrix and that's helpful. Next asks: 
- Monica: if you can post the attestation letter and key-rotation policy as separate files that will help our audit tracker.
- Marissa: when you upload the anonymized sample logs, please include a small CSV extract that maps column names to our internal fields — that will speed validation.

We plan to open a procurement RFQ next week; having those two items (Q3 & Q7) addressed will avoid a commercial exception.

Thanks again,
James Porter
Director, Information Security
